## Result

Describe the complete feature or setup change and link its HTML spec and ADRs.

## Verification

Record commands, outcomes, target coverage, and remaining device checks.

## Review

- [ ] The branch contains 1–6 intentional commits.
- [ ] Specs and documentation reflect the final behavior.
- [ ] New technology has the owner's approval and an architect's crate assessment.
- [ ] An ADR changing to approved is reserved for the owner's merge.
